## Fluid/ALE interpretation

The raw preCICE buffer is a 200-point mapped fluid field. Its mean reproduces the accepted structure absolute displacement for the accepted states that are subsequently read; the fingerprint `received_displacement` value is an internal point-field summary after adapter interpolation, so it is not expected to equal the raw structure point component at every fluid point.

- Actual point motion was nonzero in `24` of the 25 accepted summaries; the underlying 50 solve-state audit reports 47/50 nonzero states.
- Maximum mesh velocity: `18.1173244 m/s`; maximum mesh Co: `58.7519707`.
- Maximum force norm: `2121.13919 N`; maximum `omega`: `925092.9681176426`; maximum `|U|`: `392.2742170025 m/s`.
- Cell volume stayed positive, and rollback fingerprints/transport IDs passed in the preceding qualification. Thus the observed failure is not explained by displacement double accumulation or a rollback identity failure.

## Energy audit

`Ek`, `Es`, `P=F·v`, and damping work are **not evaluable from the existing run evidence**: numeric q/qdot/qddot vectors and M/K data are absent; only hashes were logged. No finite-difference surrogate was substituted for ANCF velocities.

## Final decision

`DISPLACEMENT_ACCUMULATION_FOUND` is rejected by the source and raw-buffer evidence. The observed late-window chain is: large fluid force -> large absolute structural displacement changes -> high mesh velocity/mesh Courant -> rapidly growing flow velocity and omega -> further force growth. Within the permitted classifications, the evidence supports `FLUID_FORCE_FEEDBACK_RUNAWAY`, with ALE motion acting as an amplification path; it is not sufficient to label this an ALE-only failure.

No code, solver setting, turbulence setting, relaxation, or physical parameter was modified. No 50-window or production FSI run was started.
